description: This file defines data structures and classes for representing and managing a test tree, including types for test items, groups, and the TestTree class with methods for building, filtering, and manipulating the test hierarchy.

classes.name: TestTree
classes.description: Class for constructing and managing a hierarchical representation of test suites, test cases, and test results.

methods.name: sortAndPropagateStatus
methods.description: Sorts children of a tree item and updates its status based on children's statuses.

methods.name: collectTestIds
methods.description: Collects all test IDs within a given tree item.
